title: Clean Development project configuration (.clean-development.json)
description: Schema v2 (clean-development 0.6.0). Schema v1 files (0.2-0.5) are still read: enabled is honoured, other keys are ignored, and `clean-development migrate --write DIR` converts them.

enabled.description: false: the hooks never clean this repo's declared directories.

heavy.description: Large builds or downloads are normal here; the session-start message warns in internal mode.

buildDirs.description: Repo-relative build output. Deleted at session end in internal mode and when the repo has been idle for 14 days; only when git-ignored.

depDirs.description: Repo-relative dependency folders (node_modules, .venv, Pods). Deleted only when the repo has been idle for 14 days and they are git-ignored.
